review: 702.184a-2: variant summoning_sick_creature did not change the outcome (still legal), so it was no minimal pair; replaced it with creature_controlled_by_opponent, which flips legality on the 'you control' requirement.

scenarios.title: Station taps another creature and puts charge counters equal to its power on the permanent

setup.notes: Galvanizing Sawship is a noncreature Spacecraft with no counters. It becomes an artifact creature with flying and haste at 3 or more charge counters.

decisions: A activates the station ability of Galvanizing Sawship, tapping Hill Giant as the cost.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: tap_hill_giant
variants.expected: Hill Giant becomes tapped as the cost. Galvanizing Sawship gets 3 charge counters (Hill Giant's power) and, being at station 3, is an artifact creature 6/5 with flying and haste. Grizzly Bears and Wall of Wood stay untapped.

variants.label: tap_grizzly_bears
variants.delta: A taps Grizzly Bears (power 2) as the cost instead of Hill Giant.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears becomes tapped. Galvanizing Sawship gets 2 charge counters and, being below station 3, remains a noncreature artifact. Hill Giant stays untapped.

variants.label: tap_wall_of_wood
variants.delta: A taps Wall of Wood (power 0) as the cost instead of Hill Giant.
variants.expected: Wall of Wood becomes tapped. The ability resolves and puts 0 charge counters on Galvanizing Sawship, which stays a noncreature artifact with no counters.

scenarios.forge_notes: Counter type is CHARGE. Station is implemented as a PutCounter ability with cost tapXType<1/Creature.Other> and SorcerySpeed.

scenarios.title: Station can be activated only as a sorcery and only by tapping another untapped creature
decisions: A checks whether the station ability of Galvanizing Sawship can be activated, with Hill Giant as the creature to tap.

variants.label: untapped_creature_main_phase
variants.expected: The activation is legal: Hill Giant is another untapped creature A controls and it is A's main phase with an empty stack.

variants.label: creature_already_tapped
variants.expected: The activation is not legal: A controls no other untapped creature to tap.

variants.label: not_sorcery_timing
variants.delta: The step is A's end step instead of main1.
variants.expected: The activation is not legal: station can be activated only as a sorcery, and it is not a main phase.

variants.label: creature_controlled_by_opponent
variants.delta: Hill Giant is on B's battlefield instead of A's.
variants.expected: The activation is not legal: A controls no other untapped creature to tap.

scenarios.title: A static ability makes station use toughness instead of power

setup.notes: Tapestry Warden's second ability makes each creature its controller has with toughness greater than power station permanents using its toughness. Wall of Wood is 0/3.

decisions: A activates the station ability of Galvanizing Sawship, tapping Wall of Wood as the cost.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: warden_under_your_control
variants.expected: Wall of Wood becomes tapped. Galvanizing Sawship gets 3 charge counters (Wall of Wood's toughness) and is an artifact creature 6/5 with flying and haste.

variants.label: warden_under_opponents_control
variants.delta: Tapestry Warden is on B's battlefield instead of A's.
variants.expected: Wall of Wood becomes tapped. Galvanizing Sawship gets 0 charge counters (Wall of Wood's power) and stays a noncreature artifact.

scenarios.forge_notes: The static ability is Mode$ TapPowerValue with ValidSA$ Activated.Station.
